verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents two outbound paths. You can download a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas. There is also an official MCP server through which a client can read the Model, including Pages, tables and Variables. Neither is a warehouse-oriented export or general-purpose data API: the MCP server is aimed at AI agents, issues no API keys and requires each client to sign in as a person, and no OpenAPI spec was found. The Snowflake and Postgres connections are inbound only. missing for 10: a documented REST/data API or bulk export for metrics, forecasts and scenario results; token-based headless access for internal tools; scheduled or automated push into a warehouse; independent corroboration.
